text.what: The centipede, one of the standing Cordilleran figures, alongside snakes, eagles, ferns, rice grains and mountains.
text.story: The motifs are the motifs of the weaving and the pottery. A tattoo tradition in the Philippines is not a separate art with its own vocabulary; it is the same vocabulary applied to a person.
